# `tfctl variable`

The `tfctl variable` command provides subcommands for managing workspace and variable set variables.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl variable <subcommand> [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl variable` command provides subcommands for managing workspace and variable set variables. Use these commands to import variables from configuration files.

## Subcommands

- [`import`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/variable/import) - Import variables from a file

## Examples

The following command imports variables from a `.tfvars` file:

```shell-session
$ tfctl variable import variables.tfvars
```
